actual_tool_parameters.prompt:
Draw one NEW COMPLETE full-body adult Bunny character illustration, head to shoe soles, clean white portrait canvas preferably1024x1536. Fresh full-canvas Japanese hand-drawn lineart and clean hard cel color; not a local patch, pasted head, filter or transformed existing pixels. One complete character, no text/insets.
Image1 is the SAME-VIEW newly approved BELT-ONLY full figure and sole outfit/body/pose reference. Preserve her exact build, body/head proportions, head shape, silver-white hair groups, blue eyes if visible, close naturally attached ears, orange front-longer/back-shorter jacket, white cropped top, red shorts, all hands/socks/shoes/right thighgear and OG left sleeve pocket. Keep the single black waist belt through RED SHORTS LOOPS exactly in Image1. Upper body/midriff stays absolutely free of equipment straps; no torso harness/H/underbust strap/vertical connection/hook/chain/metal clip between shirt or jacket and belt. NO weapons or sheaths.
Image2 is the HEADGEAR design only: use its matching RAISED GOGGLES panel (white frame, dark lens, small orange side hinge, one black head strap). Add only this existing headgear. No headphones/ear cups/new devices. Do not move any body or face features.
Character RIGHT=red wrist with plain full-finger black glove and right thigh terminal/pouch/white short sock; character LEFT=orange wrist device and orange-edged fingerless glove/orange thigh-high. Preserve all occlusion and visible hand orientations from1, no mirroring. Headgear's black band stays only around the HEAD, never on body. Clean navy outlines, broad cool-gray/lavender hair shadow groups, closed hard garment shadows and stable local colors. No white blotches/randomflecks/noisygrain/cloudytexture/patina or oily soft3D shading. Preserve normal white materials and functional seams/knit details.
STRICT FRONT. Raised goggles on forehead above blue eyes, eyes unobstructed. Current black buckle is ONLY at FRONT center waistband, its red trouser loops remain. Character RIGHT is imageLEFT; OG remains on characterLEFT sleeve imageRIGHT. Preserve oval chest opening, jacket lapels and their front length.

native_output.record_note: Output metadata retains the actual returned native path; image payload is stored as the byte-exact original, not fabricated as a data URL.

reference_basis: Ordered actual references match the request. Current jacket/body/head references preserve identity and clothing; any old torso harness in a reference is explicitly superseded by the prompt.
method: built-in image_gen.imagegen complete-image generation; byte-exact PNG copy and lossless WebP only
limitations: Visual design reference, not new body or garment coordinate measurements. Existing approved measurement sources remain unchanged.
No weapon or sheath included in these cumulative views.
